items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the latest security updates as soon as possible.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a full-page cache extension for Magento and Adobe Commerce, which can lead to remote code execution. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass. Key vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-34686 (Stored XSS, arbitrary code execution) and CVE-2026-34653 (Path Traversal, arbitrary file system write).

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw, named PolyShell, in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. While fixed in Magento 2.4.9, older supported versions remain vulnerable without specific mitigation.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical security vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise customer accounts. Specific CVEs include CVE-2026-21284 (Incorrect Authorization), CVE-2026-21285 (Improper Access Control), and CVE-2026-21310 (Stored XSS).

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE and Account Takeover in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical (CVSS 9.1) improper input validation and nested deserialization flaw in the Adobe Commerce REST API allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution. Mass attacks exploiting this vulnerability were observed starting in October 2025.

items.title: CosmicSting: Critical File Read and RCE in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.summary: This critical (CVSS 9.8) vulnerability allows bad actors to read any files, such as passwords and other secrets, and can lead to remote code execution and malware injection. Adobe confirmed exploitation in the wild in limited attacks targeting Adobe Commerce merchants.
